text: {"question":"How does the inclusion of the FAP data affect the BIC evidence against the ΛCDM model compared to the earlier analysis that used only SNIa, CMB, BAO, and CC data?","reference_answer":"Adding the FAP data strengthens the BIC evidence against ΛCDM, making the GPAge parameterizations strongly preferred over ΛCDM, whereas the earlier analysis already showed positive to very strong evidence against ΛCDM but with less decisive preference for the GPAge models.","passage_1_contribution":"Earlier analysis listed BIC differences relative to ΛCDM, indicating positive to very strong evidence against the candidate model.","passage_2_contribution":"Later analysis reports that with FAP data the BIC differences become even more favorable for GPAge models over ΛCDM, showing stronger evidence.","joint_reason":"Both passages discuss BIC differences as a measure of evidence against ΛCDM, with the later passage showing an update due to additional data.","same_quantity":true}
